Delhi to the Maldives,
door to water villa.

facts.label: Non-stop time
facts.text: Direct DEL–MLE when scheduled; otherwise a quick one-stop via a hub.

facts.label: The part that matters
facts.text: Resort transfers run by daylight. Your landing time decides everything.

facts.label: The cabin to take
facts.text: Short enough that the seat is about arriving calm and fresh, not sleeping.

facts.label: Distance
facts.text: The flying is easy. Timing it to the island is the craft.

intro.note: A short flight, then a transfer most travellers underestimate. We plan around it first.
intro.statement: The flight is easy. The arrival window is everything.
intro.lede: Delhi–Malé is barely four hours, so the cabin matters less than the timing. The detail that decides your day is the onward transfer. Many resorts are reached by seaplane, which generally operates only in daylight, so an evening landing can mean a night in Malé before you reach the island. Speedboat resorts are more forgiving, but they still run to a schedule. So we book the flight to fit the transfer, not the other way around, and plan the whole door-to-villa journey as one.

list.heading: Carriers & aircraft.
list.lede: Direct service comes and goes by season; one-stops via the Gulf or South India are common. Your advisor confirms the exact aircraft, the cabin, and above all the arrival time before you commit.

items.name: Indian carriers
items.text: IndiGo and other Indian airlines fly DEL–MLE directly, mostly on single-aisle aircraft, with frequency rising around peak season. The schedule is excellent. We are honest about the cabin, and we time the landing for a same-day transfer.

items.name: Via a South India hub
items.text: Connections via Bengaluru, Cochin or Chennai can give you better timings into Malé and a smoother same-day seaplane window. Useful when the direct flight lands too late for the onward transfer.

items.name: Gulf carriers
items.text: Emirates (via Dubai), Qatar Airways (via Doha) and Etihad (via Abu Dhabi) serve Malé with full premium cabins. Worth it for a true business or first product on the long leg, for award space, or when their morning arrivals suit the transfer better than a direct evening one.

items.name: Sri Lankan & regional
items.text: A connection via Colombo or another regional hub can line up the timings or the fare neatly. We weigh the extra hour against the better arrival window.

items.name: The resort transfer
items.text: Not an airline, but the leg that matters most. Trans Maldivian and resort-run boats carry you from Malé to the island. Daylight seaplane windows, luggage and lounge waits all turn on your flight time. We book it as part of the journey.
